lessons.title: Lesson 1: Coping with Stress & Pressure
objectives: Nắm vững các khái niệm và định nghĩa cốt lõi của Lesson 1: Coping with Stress & Pressure.
Hiểu và áp dụng thành thạo các quy tắc và công thức trong SGK.
Rèn luyện kỹ năng phân tích và giải quyết các bài toán/tình huống thực tiễn.

concepts.definition: A concise reported clause where question words (who, what, where, when, how) are followed by 'to + verb'.
concepts.example: I don't know what to do to overcome exam anxiety.
concepts.essence: Replaces longer clauses like 'what I should do' or 'where I ought to go'.

concepts.definition: Balancing academic demands with physical workouts, sufficient sleep (8 hours), and emotional well-being.
concepts.example: Teens should take regular breaks and talk to school counselors when feeling overwhelmed.
concepts.essence: Healthy minds reside in healthy bodies.

rules.statement: Reported speech transformation with question word + to-V
rules.meaning: S + asked/wondered + Wh-word + to-infinitive when the subject of both clauses is the same.
rules.example: 'Where should I register for the course?' -> She wondered where to register for the course.
rules.essence: Cannot be used with the question word 'why'.

workedExamples.prompt: Rewrite the sentence: 'He told me how I could solve this difficult math problem.' using question word + to-V.
steps: Bước 1: Xác định mệnh đề danh ngữ: 'how I could solve this difficult math problem'.
Bước 2: Thay 'I could solve' bằng 'to solve'.
Bước 3: Viết lại: 'He told me how to solve this difficult math problem.'
workedExamples.answer: He told me how to solve this difficult math problem.

commonMistakes.mistake: Using 'why' with to-infinitive: 'I wonder why to do that.'
commonMistakes.why: 'Why' cannot be followed by to-infinitive in English. You must say: 'I wonder why I should do that.'
